evidence.statement: Screening benchmark: predictions scored on published single tracks; not validation

protocol.clusters: parameter set via lpbf_calibration_stats.set_key = (source, material, power_W, speed_mm_s, beamDiameter_um)
protocol.heldOut: per (material, source) block of the trainable sources; sources a submission declares in trainedOnSources are excluded and marked as such
metrics: meanAbsLn = mean |ln(pred / meas)| on resolved rows
mapeUnresolvedAsFailPct (an unresolved row counts as a 100 % error)

skill.baseline: frozen Rosenthal kernel at its default absorptivity
skill.statistic: 1 - MAPE_A / MAPE_B on the common resolved rows

protocol.unresolved: a missing, blank row counts as unresolved; mapeUnresolvedAsFail scores it as a 100 % error

sentinelNote: catalog sentinels (used during physics development, not blind): reported separately, never trained on, never in the gate
truthSource: read at scoring time from the pinned loaders (lpbf_calibration_fit.load_rows); never published here
